fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Live game state kept in battery memory (battle/map work, unit, pilot, name and item tables). The save slots are copies of parts of it; it is not a save by itself
fields.evidence: diff: changes during play in nearly every state; writers d000:a4ac/a726 copy 1515/2151/24d1/2cfc/3053/33d3/0ec9 from here (slot bytes equal the live bytes in every battle save)

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Save-area signature, value 007B. If this or its copy at 7424 is wrong, or the area checksum fails, the game rebuilds the save area with all slots empty at start-up
fields.evidence: code d000:af3c (start-up check and rebuild, called from e000:f1db and e000:f144); value 7b in all states after boot

fields.name: area checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum of the whole save area: 16-bit sum of little-endian words over 33EB-741A, computed in 16-byte strides (1027 strides); carry dropped. Copy at 7426
fields.evidence: code d000:b0a6 (slot index >= 3 branch) and c000:4d5a; recomputed over all 302 post-boot saves, all match (empty e.g. 8c51; battle saves 645c, 1f18, 2019)

fields.name: suspend: money
fields.meaning: Money (funds) at the moment of the battle save
fields.evidence: diff 500 -> 1000 -> 501 across saves equals the on-screen funds 500/1000; code d000:a726 <- RAM 0244, adder f000:8b5b caps at 9,999,999

fields.name: suspend: counter
fields.meaning: Unknown 32-bit value saved next to money; 0 in these saves
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 096b; cleared by d000:9dd8/d000:9518; no other writer in the decompiled set

fields.name: suspend: battle value A
fields.meaning: Unknown battle-only value; 0 in these saves
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 096f; restored by d000:aa08; cleared at new game; no other user found

fields.name: suspend: battle value B
fields.meaning: Unknown battle-only value; 0 in these saves
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 0971; restored by d000:aa08; cleared at new game; no other user found

fields.name: suspend: map index
fields.meaning: Current map/stage number, 0-based (0 on the first map)
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 0248; used as a data-table index by d000:68b0 (skips 0248 lists) and d000:b736 (0248*8 entry + text display); cleared by d000:b924

fields.name: suspend: battle flags
fields.meaning: Battle state flags (1000h in these saves); on resume the game ORs in flag 0400h; only the low 3 bits survive the post-battle cleanup
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 024a; d000:aa08 sets bit 0400h after loading; e000:f144 masks &= 7; cleared at map start c000:004e

fields.name: suspend: map turn
fields.meaning: Turns played on the current map, starting at 0
fields.evidence: diff 2 -> 3 over one played turn; code d000:a4ac <- RAM 0242, set to 0 at map start c000:004e

fields.name: suspend: battle work block
fields.meaning: Unknown battle-only block (RAM 08DC dump); only byte +0x13 (file 0x3410) is nonzero (=3) in these saves
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac copies RAM 08dc-08fb; cleared by e000:f144; no finer reader in the decompiled set

fields.name: suspend: map cursor row
fields.meaning: Map cursor row (Y), 0 at the top, +1 per step down
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 02fc; c000:1310 derives the map row scroll from 02fc and c000:03d8 multiplies it by the map width; diff: vertical walks change only this byte

fields.name: suspend: map cursor column
fields.meaning: Map cursor column (X), 0 at the left, +1 per step right
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 02fb; c000:1310/03d8 use 02fb as the column term; diff: horizontal walks change only this byte

fields.name: suspend: battle values
fields.meaning: Six unknown battle-only 16-bit values; zero in these saves
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac <- RAM 0179-0184; restored by d000:aa08; cleared by d000:9518

fields.name: suspend: total turns
fields.meaning: Total turns; the screen shows this value plus 1
fields.evidence: diff 2 -> 3 while the screen shows turn count 3 -> 4; code d000:a726 <- RAM 0240 (from carried-over value & 3FFh at new game d000:c9cb)

fields.name: suspend: story progress
fields.meaning: Story progress block (scene index, cleared-map bits, event flags); all zero in these saves (first map)
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 08fc-091b; same block as in the numbered save slots; cleared by e000:f144

fields.name: suspend: owner name
fields.meaning: Console owner name in console name codes (0x0B-0x24 = A-Z, NUL padded); WONDERSWAN here
fields.evidence: bytes decode to WONDERSWAN = the live console profile name (sibling trees keep it at profile bytes 60-69); code d000:9ffe reads console words 0x30-0x37 into RAM 093b

fields.name: suspend: owner birth year
fields.meaning: Owner birth year from the console profile (0 here: profile fields empty)
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 094b; d000:9dd8 converts console word 0x38 from BCD, defaults 0

fields.name: suspend: owner birth month
fields.meaning: Owner birth month from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 094d; <- console word 0x39 via d000:9dd8

fields.name: suspend: owner birth day
fields.meaning: Owner birth day from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 094e; <- console word 0x39 via d000:9dd8

fields.name: suspend: owner sex
fields.meaning: Owner sex from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 094f; <- console word 0x3A low via d000:9dd8

fields.name: suspend: owner blood type
fields.meaning: Owner blood type from the console profile
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 0950; <- console word 0x3A high via d000:9dd8

fields.name: suspend: battle units
fields.meaning: 54 on-map unit records of 58 bytes (status, position, HP, energy and other per-unit battle state)
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac copies 54 x 3Ah from work memory 0x1515 (indexer f000:5204: AX*3Ah+1515h); slot bytes equal the live bytes in every battle save; records change after combat

fields.name: suspend: battle objects
fields.meaning: 64 map-object records of 14 bytes
fields.evidence: code d000:a4ac copies 64 x 0Eh from work memory 0x2151 (indexer f000:527e: AX*0Eh+2151h); slot bytes equal the live bytes

fields.name: suspend: unit table
fields.meaning: 123 owned-unit (robot) records of 17 bytes
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 copies 123 x 11h from work memory 0x24d1 (indexer f000:524a: AX*11h+24d1h); slot bytes equal the live bytes

fields.name: suspend: pilot table
fields.meaning: 95 pilot records of 9 bytes
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 copies 95 x 9 from work memory 0x2cfc (indexer f000:52aa: AX*9+2cfch); slot bytes equal the live bytes; unchanged over the played turn

fields.name: suspend: word table
fields.meaning: 448 16-bit values used as upgrade-level nibbles (each nibble capped at 10 when read)
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 copies from work memory 0x3053 (indexer f000:52c2); reader code takes high/low nibbles and clamps to 10

fields.name: suspend: item stock
fields.meaning: 20 unknown small counters; zero here
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 copies from work memory 0x33d3 (indexer f000:52d8); no reader in the decompiled set

fields.name: suspend: names
fields.meaning: Six pilot/unit name strings in game text codes (FF-terminated; FE newline; FD substitution; F0+base = voiced kana; katakana 0x3D+gojuuon, 0xBD long vowel, 0xC0 =)
fields.evidence: renderer f000:550c; defaults in ROM d000:b89c via d000:b924; bytes decode exactly to the setup-screen names

fields.name: suspend: story group flags
fields.meaning: Story-route / party-group flags (01 here)
fields.evidence: code d000:a726 <- RAM 0960; set to 1 by d000:9518

fields.name: suspend: marker
fields.meaning: Battle save in use: 007B = valid, FFFF = empty. Continue on the title menu is only selectable when this is valid
fields.evidence: diff empty->007b on save; code d000:b046 (marker must equal the signature) and the title-menu cursor check; reviewer: Continue reachable only with the save

fields.name: suspend: checksum
fields.meaning: Battle save checksum: 16-bit word sum over 33EB-53BA (509 16-byte strides; the last 3 data bytes are not covered)
fields.evidence: code d000:b0a6 slot 0; recomputed on all 3 battle saves (e485, 091c, 081e), all match
